item.tib: ma cig bka' gsang lha mo'i gtor bskang
item.coloph: ma cig bka' gsang lha mo'i rgyud las nang gtor ma'i bskang (skong) ba/ phyi rabs kyi don du dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyis mdzad nas lha klu mi gsum snang mdog bzhi la gdams pa'o/ des bon gshen gsum la brgyud/ des zhang zhung gshen gsum la brgyud/ des rgya bod sgom gshen gsum la brgyud/ des phrom bod zhang zhung gsum la brgyud des se lde me gsum la brgyad/ des bla chen dran pa nam mkha' la brgyad/ des rje chen lha sgom mu thur/ stong (stang) dmu tsha gyer med/ rang sang khod ram bzhi la brgyud/ gshen po de bzhi'i phyi rabs kyi don du gsang ba'i brag la sgrub pa bsnyen nas bka' gter gnyis su spros nas phyi rabs las ldan gyi gshen po spral sku blo ldan snying po la brgyud nas/ dus kyis 'phel ba'i rgyud la ba ga 'od zer rgyal mtshan gyis yi dam du bzhengs pa la zhal bshus pa dge legs 'phel//
